question: Which cloud-delivered security service provides the features of an advanced intrusion prevention system (IPS)?
Which concept provides a framework for describing how Cloud-Delivered Security Services (CDSS) fits in with the Palo Alto Networks strategic approach comprehensive security?
How does Palo Alto Networks' WildFire service help security teams?
choices: By automatically analyzing files for threats
By using machine learning for accurate device discovery
By providing visibility into unsanctioned SaaS applications
By offering in-line machine learning-based detection of malicious domains
correct: By automatically analyzing files for threats

question: What is the goal of Palo Alto Networks' cloud-delivered security services (CDSS) offerings?
choices: To replace on-box and Panorama-server-based policy management
To provide feature parity for hardware firewalls and software firewalls
To scan your infrastructure as code (IaC) scripts and cloud-based VMs for threats
To help ensure that customers can confidently secure all traffic that traverses any network
correct: To help ensure that customers can confidently secure all traffic that traverses any network

question: Which two technologies are foundational elements of the Advanced URL Filtering service? (Choose two.)
What is the primary purpose of Advanced URL Filtering?
choices: To categorize websites as benign or malicious
To provide local, highly compressed caches of website category data
correct: To categorize websites as benign or malicious

question: Which three risk categories are used in PAN-DB to classify websites? (Choose three.)
What is the first step in Advanced URL Filtering's category lookup and policy evaluation process?
choices: Firewall inspection of the URL request
Policy lookup for overrides to default settings
correct: Firewall inspection of the URL request

question: How does Advanced URL Filtering compensate for coverage gaps in database solutions?
choices: By use of aggressive fuzzy hashing
By use of Safe Search Enforcement
By providing real-time URL analysis on a per-request basis
correct: By providing real-time URL analysis on a per-request basis
